terms.seo_description: Read the MaroQuiz terms of service covering accounts, quizzes, user content, intellectual property, availability, liability and other conditions of use.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using MaroQuiz, you agree to these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the platform.

eligibility.title: Eligibility
eligibility.content: MaroQuiz is intended for users aged 13 and older. If you are under the legal age of majority in your country, you may only use MaroQuiz with the involvement of a parent or legal guardian where required by applicable law.

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content: Some features require you to create an account. You are responsible for providing accurate information and maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You are responsible for activities performed through your account. You must not use another person's account, impersonate another person, provide false or misleading information, or allow others to use your account in a way that violates these Terms. MaroQuiz may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, misuse the platform, or engage in fraudulent, abusive, or unlawful activity. You may request deletion of your account at any time through our contact page or feedback form.

quizzes.title: Educational Content
quizzes.content: MaroQuiz provides educational quizzes, practice materials, and other learning resources intended to support learning and preparation. Quiz content may be updated, corrected, replaced, or removed at any time. While we aim to provide accurate and useful content, we do not guarantee that all content will always be complete, error-free, or up to date. MaroQuiz does not guarantee success in any examination, competition, academic program, or other assessment.

userContent.title: User-Generated Content
userContent.content: Certain features, including the blog and question-and-answer areas, may allow users to submit content. You are responsible for the content you submit and must ensure that it complies with applicable laws and does not violate the rights of others. You must not submit content that is unlawful, fraudulent, abusive, misleading, defamatory, discriminatory, harmful, or infringing. By submitting content, you grant MaroQuiz a non-exclusive right to store, display, reproduce, and distribute that content as reasonably necessary to operate and provide the platform. MaroQuiz may review, moderate, restrict, or remove user-generated content that violates these Terms or may adversely affect the platform or its users.

intellectual.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual.content: Unless otherwise stated, MaroQuiz's name, branding, logos, design, software, quizzes, educational content, and other original materials remain the property of MaroQuiz or their respective rights holders. You may not copy, reproduce, distribute, modify, sell, or commercially exploit MaroQuiz materials without prior permission, except where permitted by applicable law.

thirdParty.title: Advertising and Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: MaroQuiz may display advertisements in the future and may use third-party services, including advertising, analytics, authentication, hosting, and other service providers. Third-party services are subject to their own terms and privacy policies. MaroQuiz is not responsible for the content, availability, accuracy, or practices of third-party websites or services.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Use
prohibited.content: You agree not to attempt unauthorized access to MaroQuiz or another user's account, interfere with the operation, availability, or security of the platform, use automated systems to scrape, overload, or abuse the platform, introduce malicious code or harmful content, submit fraudulent, unlawful, abusive, or infringing content, circumvent access restrictions, security measures, or usage limits, or use MaroQuiz for unlawful or harmful purposes.

availability.title: Availability and Changes
availability.content: We may modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of MaroQuiz, including features, content, or services, at any time. We may also update these Terms from time to time. Updated Terms will be published on this page with a revised "Last updated" date.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: MaroQuiz is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis to the extent permitted by applicable law. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, complete accuracy of content, or that the platform will meet every user's individual requirements. To the extent permitted by applicable law, MaroQuiz is not responsible for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages resulting from the use of, or inability to use, the platform.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law

contact.title: Contact

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seo_description: Read the MaroQuiz privacy policy to learn how personal data is collected, used, protected, retained and handled on the platform.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect the information you provide when creating an account, such as your name, email address, and optional profile details such as your university, major, and academic year. We may also collect information related to your use of MaroQuiz, including quiz activity, scores, XP, achievements, and study streaks generated through your use of the platform. If you choose to sign in using Google, we may receive information provided by that service, such as your name, email address, and profile picture, as necessary to create and authenticate your account.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use your information to create and manage your account, authenticate your access to the platform, track and display your learning progress, provide quiz results, achievements, XP, and streaks, personalize and improve the MaroQuiz experience, and maintain, secure, and improve the platform and its services.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to help protect personal information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. However, no online service can guarantee absolute security.

cookies.title: Cookies and Advertising
cookies.content: Essential features remain available without optional cookies. With your consent, Google Analytics 4 measures page visits using generalized route patterns, without account details, quiz answers or authentication tokens. Non-personalized Google AdSense advertising and related cookies require a separate choice. Your choices are stored in your browser for up to 180 days. Use Cookie settings on any page to change or withdraw consent. Turning advertising off after it has loaded reloads the page to stop it. Premium users do not see advertisement placements.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: MaroQuiz may use third-party services for purposes such as authentication, hosting, analytics, communications, advertising, and other platform functionality. These services may process information in accordance with their own terms and privacy policies.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account remains active, or as needed to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time through the contact page or feedback form. Where appropriate, we may retain certain information when necessary to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, prevent abuse or fraud, or protect the security of the platform.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, subject to applicable laws. You may also request information about how your personal information is used. Requests can be submitted through our contact page or feedback form.

children.title: Age Requirement
children.content: MaroQuiz is intended for users aged 13 and older. If you are under the legal age of majority in your country, you may only use MaroQuiz with the involvement of a parent or legal guardian where required by applicable law.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.content: This Privacy Policy is governed by the applicable laws of Morocco. Any disputes relating to this policy shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of Morocco, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal information, you can contact us through the contact page or feedback form.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion Instructions
dataDeletion.seo_description: Learn how to request deletion of your MaroQuiz account and personal data, what information is deleted, and the expected timeframe.

intro.title: Requesting Deletion
intro.content: You can request the deletion of your MaroQuiz account and all associated data at any time, including data linked to accounts created or connected through Facebook Login.

howTo.title: How to Request Deletion
howTo.content: Send a deletion request through our contact page or feedback form, including the email address associated with your account. We will verify your identity before processing the request.

whatGetsDeleted.title: What Gets Deleted
whatGetsDeleted.content: A deletion request permanently removes your account information, quiz history, scores, XP, achievements, streak data, bookmarks, messages, and any profile details you provided.

googleData.title: Data From Google Login
googleData.content: If you signed up or logged in using Google, we only receive your name, email address, and profile picture from Google to create and authenticate your account. Disconnecting Google Login alone does not delete your MaroQuiz account — to remove all data, including information originally obtained via Google, please submit a full deletion request as described above.

timeframe.title: Processing Time
timeframe.content: Deletion requests are processed within 30 days. You will receive a confirmation once your account and data have been permanently removed.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have questions about data deletion, you can reach out through the contact page or feedback form.

about.title: About MaroQuiz
about.intro: MaroQuiz was born from a simple idea: students preparing for university exams deserve an effective, accessible, and straightforward way to practice — with relevant learning resources, quizzes with explanations, and content directly aligned with their learning goals.
about.solo_dev: This platform is built and maintained by a single developer, not a company. There's no team, no funding, no investors — just someone who wanted to build something genuinely useful for students and kept improving it one feature at a time.
about.growing: MaroQuiz is still growing. New majors, subjects, and quizzes get added regularly, and every piece of feedback from real users directly shapes what gets built next.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1_answer: Yes. Creating an account, taking quizzes, and tracking your progress is free. Some advanced features may be part of an optional premium tier in the future, but core practice tools stay accessible.
faq.q2_question: Do I need an account to try a quiz?
faq.q2_answer: No. You can try a random 20-question trial quiz for any major or subject directly from the homepage without signing up. Creating an account lets you save your progress, track stats, and access the full quiz library.
faq.q3_question: What's the difference between Tutor Mode and Exam Mode?
faq.q3_answer: Tutor Mode shows you whether each answer is correct immediately, along with an explanation. Exam Mode holds all feedback until you finish the quiz, simulating real exam conditions.
faq.q4_question: How is the leaderboard ranking calculated?
faq.q4_answer: Rankings are based on XP earned from completing quizzes. You can view global, country, major, and subject-specific leaderboards.
faq.q5_question: Can I add or request a subject that isn't available yet?
faq.q5_answer: Yes — use the feedback form to suggest a major, subject, or quiz topic you'd like to see added.
faq.q6_question: I found a bug or incorrect question. How do I report it?
faq.q6_answer: Use the "Report Question" button while taking a quiz, or submit details through the feedback form.

concoursPdfs.rights: I have reviewed this PDF and confirm permission to distribute it publicly.
concoursPdfs.approvalHelp: Saving without publication keeps the document private and clears previous approval. Legacy files are never published automatically.

preparationFilters.label: Grade, level, specialty or track
preparationFilters.allHelp: All includes approved documents without a filter assignment. This selection applies to previous exams, summaries and guides.
preparationFilters.correctionContext: Exam shown for a correction matching this filter.
preparationFilters.adminHelp: Configure optional options for this concours, independently of subjects and categories. One parent level is supported. Deactivation hides an option, never its PDFs from All.
preparationFilters.saveConcoursFirst: Save this concours first, then reopen it to configure filters.
preparationFilters.assignmentHelp: Select zero, one or several applicable options after reviewing the document content.
preparationFilters.assignmentSaveHelp: This saves only filter assignments, preserving the PDF, approval and correction link. Save or discard other metadata edits first.
preparationFilters.saveError: Unable to save preparation filters. Please retry.
preparationFilters.legacyHelp: Legacy descriptive metadata. Use the configured options above for reliable filtering.

concoursQcm.title: QCM selected for this concours
concoursQcm.relatedHelp: Quizzes selected directly or through relevant subjects appear together in the QCM section above. Each available quiz appears only once.
concoursQcm.filterHelp: Filter exams, QCM, summaries and guides. All includes unclassified documents; concours-wide QCM also appear in every track.
concoursQcm.emptyBody: No available quiz has been associated with this concours or the selected track yet.
concoursQcm.loadError: Unable to load QCM preparation. Please retry.
concoursQcm.adminHelp: Select existing subjects or quizzes. A subject includes its available quizzes automatically. Direct and subject associations are combined without duplicating quizzes.
concoursQcm.scopeHelp: No option selected means the entire concours and every track. Select one or several options to restrict this association. A broader subject association still includes its quizzes.

concoursFollowing.allTracks: No selection means all concours announcements. A parent track includes its specialties.
concoursFollowing.browserChannel: Allow the browser channel for this concours
concoursFollowing.browserHelp: Save the browser channel for your chosen concours, then enable this browser. You can disable it at any time.
concoursFollowing.unsupported: Push notifications are unavailable in this browser or context.
concoursFollowing.browserUnavailable: Browser notifications have not yet been enabled on MaroQuiz.
concoursFollowing.permissionDenied: Permission was not granted. Following preferences remain available.
concoursFollowing.browserError: Could not enable notifications. Retry or use the MaroQuiz bell.
concoursFollowing.deliveryPending: Following saved. Alert delivery has not yet been enabled.
concoursFollowing.loadError: Could not load your followed concours.
concoursFollowing.saveError: Could not save. Check the tracks and retry.
concoursFollowing.conflict: These preferences changed. Reload before continuing.
concoursFollowing.empty: You are not following any concours.
concoursFollowing.promotion: Follow a concours from its permanent page and choose your tracks and alert channels.

discoveryBilingual.conflict: The two versions contain different facts: review before matching them.
discoveryBilingual.editorialHelp: Check both versions against the official notice. Leave a missing translation empty; there is no automatic translation.
discoveryBilingual.rejectHelp: Rejecting keeps the source history. A note is sufficient; it does not verify or publish the notice.

factsVideo.changed: The facts changed after estimation. Update the selection to recalculate before generating.
factsVideo.title: Facts Video Generator
factsVideo.subtitle: Turn verified facts into animated videos, from one admin screen.
factsVideo.subject: Subject
factsVideo.narration: Text-first mode. Voice synthesis and narration uploads are not installed.
factsVideo.automatic: Calculated from the selected text, reading time, animations, transitions, introduction and outro.
factsVideo.available: distinct verified facts available in this language
factsVideo.tooLong: This selection exceeds 60 seconds. Reduce the fact count or choose Long YouTube for more comfortable social pacing.
factsVideo.noTarget: Duration follows the content. No fixed target, filler or repeated facts.
factsVideo.runnerOffline: The local renderer or API is unavailable. Start start-maroquiz-video-renderer.cmd and retry.

revisionReview.title: Revision JSON & draft review
revisionReview.subtitle: Select quizzes, load their explanations and review revision paragraphs.
revisionReview.localOnly: Draft generation and local review only. Optional edits are lost when this page reloads; rendered batches are retained locally. Stored quiz explanations are never changed. Nothing is published.
revisionReview.subject: Subject
revisionReview.incompleteCount: The explanation count is partial until every selected quiz has loaded successfully.
revisionReview.excluded: {{count}} ineligible quizzes were not selected. Their errors remain listed below.
revisionReview.loadingSources: Loading source explanations (at most two requests at a time)…
revisionReview.noQuizzes: No quizzes are available for this subject.
revisionReview.noRendering: Image pagination and progress appear in the generation results
revisionReview.reviewHelp: Each source starts as one unchanged paragraph. Edit manually or merge selected paragraphs; merging joins their exact text and retains all source mappings. Check the complete meaning and conditions against the sources. Edits invalidate approval.
revisionReview.unmapped: This source has no paragraph mapping. Add a mapping and resolve the review issue.
revisionReview.approvalBlocked: Approval requires nonempty paragraphs with valid mappings, all sources mapped and all review issues resolved.
revisionReview.acknowledge: I have compared every paragraph and source mapping, checked the conditions and reviewed this exact version.
revisionReview.previewHelp: Continuous draft preview. Downloaded PNGs are paginated at a fixed 28 px handwriting size with quiz-local page numbers. Sources stay outside the sheet.
revisionReview.jsonHelp: The existing exporter returns source JSON, separate from your edits. Generating fresh JSON does not replace an existing draft snapshot. Difficulty remains source metadata only.
revisionReview.loadQuizzesError: Failed to load every quiz page. No partial list can be selected.
revisionReview.sourceError: Failed to load this quiz source. Retry or change the selection.
revisionReview.approvalError: Unable to calculate approval hash. Use a supported browser on localhost or HTTPS.
revisionReview.invalidSource: This quiz is empty or contains missing explanations.
revisionReview.invalidProvenance: The source needs unique stable question IDs and an accurate explanation count. Refresh after the exporter update.
revisionReview.wrongSource: The returned source does not belong to the selected major, subject and quiz.
revisionReview.sourcesBlocked: Some selected sources could not be loaded. Retry or remove those quizzes.
revisionReview.mappingBlocked: Map every source and keep paragraphs nonempty before generating. Editorial approval is not required.
revisionReview.runnerHelp: Start start-maroquiz-video-renderer.cmd and keep its console open.
revisionReview.pollError: Unable to read local rendering progress. Reload this page to reconnect to the saved batch.
revisionReview.draftOutputs: All generated images and downloads are drafts. Generation does not approve or publish content. Edits during rendering apply only to a later batch.
revisionReview.correctedMode: Corrected questions — Question, correct answer and explanation
revisionReview.correctedHelp: Only stored correct answers are included. Source wording and English technical slugs stay unchanged. Document language changes labels, not educational content.
revisionReview.correctedSourceMissing: Reload this quiz to obtain its verified question and answer context.
revisionReview.correctedMappings: Corrected questions require one separate explanation per question. Review the existing draft mappings; your edits have been preserved.
revisionReview.correctedBlocked: Some corrected-question sources or mappings are invalid. Review the visible quiz errors before generating.
revisionReview.documentLabelsError: Document label translations could not load. Retry the language selection. Source text is unchanged.

pdfBank.selectPage: Select all documents on this page
pdfBank.actionUnavailable: This action is unavailable for this document. Reload its current status.
pdfBank.invalidFile: Choose a non-empty PDF no larger than 20 MiB.
pdfBank.duplicateFile: This file is already in the upload list. It was not added again.
pdfBank.titleRequired: Each PDF needs a title of 1–255 characters.
pdfBank.uploadHelp: Each PDF is uploaded separately (20 MiB maximum). Uploads remain unpublished. Failed files can be retried without uploading successful files again.
pdfBank.confirmDelete: Delete this unpublished, unshared PDF record? Its physical file will be retained.
pdfBank.confirmPublish: Confirm publication of the listed documents. Only eligible documents will be published; already published documents remain unchanged.
pdfBank.confirmAction: Confirm this action for the listed documents. Verify each PDF before confirming distribution rights.

concoursOfficial.title: Main official announcement
concoursOfficial.selected: This is the main official announcement for this session.
concoursOfficial.eligibility: Choose a verified, published notice assigned to the displayed session. Correct a missing or incorrect session separately.
concoursOfficial.confirm: Use this announcement in the main official section for the displayed session? Other notices, documents and session history will be preserved. This does not publish or merge documents.
